weak_support_teacher_review.point: Teacher targets expected nearby silhouette support, not line-of-sight at the particular3D reference. Strong3x3 precedes footprint; otherwise it computes M4/M0 weighted support within rho=max(4,.05*reference_span).
weak_support_teacher_review.denominator: Existing5203GT-only corpus, not source primary/input-valid training pools and not human semantic gold.
weak_support_teacher_review.answer_to_systematic_mislabel_question_k: 센터M0=0인 known C가1251/2149, known V가10098/17897로 reference-pixel surface와 local-footprint target의 체계적 차이는 확인된다. 하지만 M0(r)=0만으로3D점이 공중인지/LOS가 clear인지/semantic E가 틀렸는지는 알 수 없다. 현재teacher자신의local-support정의에서 오라벨이라 단정할 수 없고, 이를 corner D/E/S로 읽는 것이 부당하다. 실제새 depth-ray/영상cue audit 전에는 systematic semantic mislabel이라고 확정하지 않는다.
weak_support_teacher_review.preservation: All old labels/primary scores/results remain unchanged; this review generates no replacement labels.

why_adds_distinct_information: It compares an independently fixed virtual-reference endpoint with observed aligned depth and visible-instance ownership, without requiring an M0 physical surface near r. Thus it can separate clear air-before-surface from genuine observed other-owner foreground, unlike M4/M0 local support. Its weak ray target still differs from visible semantic cue evidence.
minimum_future_admission_not_executed: Freeze a new source-only protocol with exact reference raster, converted range tolerance and unknown/ownership policy before any labels.
Keep separate raw depth relation, own-first-hit, other-owner and unassigned/overlap; invalid depth always U.
Audit fixed TRAIN metadata-selected examples of M0(r)=0 clear/blocked/own/missing; inspect depth registration/owner masks and original visual cue evidence separately.
Preserve original split families/query identities; no current223 selection, GT-snapping, PnP or new backbone needed for teacher generation.
Any later learned use must state logicalnative slot/fullq-context forward contract and retain human semantic benchmark as separate evaluation-only goal.
